anytime.text:
Good morning.
Rangoli first, playlist second.

The diyas are up.
So should you be.

Ladoo for breakfast?
It's Diwali, it counts.

Afternoon slump?
Kaju katli fixes that.

Your Diwali nap
needs a soundtrack.

Sun's down, diyas on.
Lighting hour, {name}.

Puja's done.
Volume's allowed now.

Crackers outside.
Better bangers in here.

Still up?
So are the neighbours' rockets.

3am crackers again.
Fine. Play on.

Happy Diwali week, {name}.
Lights on, volume up.

Soan papdi incoming.
Regift responsibly.

Relatives asking your marks?
Turn it up.

Diwali cleaning found
your old earphones. Use them.

One more sweet.
One more song.

Your diet called.
It's on leave till Bhai Dooj.

New clothes.
Same old playlist? Fix that.

Rangoli by mom,
soundtrack by you.

Card night tip:
sad songs make bluffing harder.

Neighbours on rockets.
You on repeat.

Sweets eaten: lost count.
Regrets: zero.

Ears getting
cracker-proofed.

Pollution's high.
So is the volume.

House is clean.
Queue is full.

Lighting diyas
one beat at a time.

stats.text:
{song} is brighter
than the whole lane's lights.

More {lastartist}?
Second helping, like the sweets.

You've seen {topartist} more
than your relatives this week.

{topsong} on repeat
like Diwali forwards on WhatsApp.

{song} in your Likes?
That's sweet box material.

{topartist} deserves
a sweet box from you.

{lastartist} last time.
Who's lighting it up tonight?

{song} hits harder
than a sutli bomb.

If {topartist} came over
you'd share the kaju katli. Maybe.

{topsong} played that much
has earned a Diwali bonus.

{song} is the phuljhadi
of your playlist.

greetings.text:
Happy Diwali!
May your queue never run out.

It's Diwali!
Shine brighter than every diya.

Happy Diwali!
Sweets in one hand, music in the other.

Today's the day.
Every diya lit, every banger played.

Happy Diwali, {name}.
Be louder than the crackers.

Happy Diwali!
More light, more music, less soan papdi.

Happy Diwali!
May this year sound like {topsong}.

Happy Diwali!
Here's to light winning, again.
